احتملن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَلْنَ (iḥtamalna) /iħ.ta.mal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اُحْتُمِلْنَ (uḥtumilna) /uħ.tu.mil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
# اِحْتَمِلْنَ (iḥtamilna) /iħ.ta.mil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَمَلَ (iḥtamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
